expectations.text: Supplies a short, unapologetic decline script the user can send
expectations.evidence: Section 1 ("Send this today") gives a verbatim, blockquoted email of ~90 words the user can paste and send. It declines the unpaid video directly and without apology — "I'd rather walk the panel through two of those, and the brief each was built against, than produce a new one unpaid" — opens confidently ("Thanks for the invite — looking forward to it"), contains no hedging or sorry-language, and pairs the refusal with a concrete alternative (published demos, live session). It closes with a reasonable additional ask about loop format, keeping the message brief and sendable as-is.
